# Connections Specification

## Detailed design

### API

`GET /connections` lists connections.

### MCP exposure

Decision: required

| Operation | Tool | Tier |
|---|---|---|
| GET /connections | thunderid_list_connections | read |
| `POST /connections` | `thunderid_create_connection` | write |
| GET /connections | thunderid_search_connections | read |
| GET /connections/{id} | thunderid_list_connections | read |
| PUT /connections/{id} | thunderid_save_connection | write |
| POST /connections | thunderid_save_connection | write |
| POST /connections/{id}/test | not exposed: runs a live request against the endpoint | |
| POST /connections/{id}/rotate | not exposed: returns a credential | write |
| DELETE /connections/{id} | deferred #1234 | destructive |
| PUT /connections/{id} | deferred https://github.com/thunder-id/thunderid/issues/1235 | write |

### UI

| Operation | Tool | Tier |
|---|---|---|
| this table | is outside | the section |
